finding.claim: Unauthenticated pickle deserialization in POST /update_weights gives remote code execution on default api_server configs (api_keys unset). The same missing auth exposes /init_weights_update_group, which takes attacker-chosen master_address/port.
finding.source: HTTP body field serialized_named_tensors (lmdeploy/serve/openai/protocol.py:541), arbitrary client string reachable via POST /update_weights (management.py:53-59)

trace.note: update_params(request) called with the client request
AuthenticationMiddleware only added when api_keys is set

finding.guards_checked: Auth middleware only when api_keys is set (api_server.py:409-410), no per-route auth, validate_json_request checks content type only, no signature/allowlist/safe unpickler on payload, no feature flag gating the route. Caveat: default-configuration issue; operator can mitigate with api_keys. Init-group rendezvous (agent.py:1380-1391) is a second sink under the same missing auth.

finding.claim: Proxy /nodes/* management endpoints are unauthenticated, even when --api-keys is set. This allows registering attacker URLs that receive client traffic including Authorization headers, unauthenticated node termination (DoS), and server-side fetches of arbitrary URLs.
finding.source: Unauthenticated HTTP requests to POST /nodes/add, POST /nodes/remove, POST /nodes/terminate, GET /nodes/terminate_all (lmdeploy/serve/proxy/proxy.py:492-550)
finding.sink: NodeManager.add force-register (proxy.py:165-169) and fetch (proxy.py:170-174); forwarders copy all client headers (proxy.py:450-458, 390/412) to the selected node; terminate_all drops nodes (proxy.py:210-217)

trace.note: '/nodes' in skip_prefixes, so the auth check is bypassed for /nodes/*
proxy installs the same AuthenticationMiddleware with the same skip list
get_node_url selects node by model name
chat completions route to selected node
_prepare_headers copies all headers except Host, including Authorization

finding.guards_checked: Auth middleware bypassed for /nodes prefix. add() has no URL validation or _is_safe_url check. Header forwarding has no allowlist. Proxy CORS is wildcard with credentials (proxy.py:464-470). Not verified by a live test.

finding.claim: Unauthenticated chat clients can read arbitrary local files on the server via file:// or raw path values in multimodal image/video/audio/time_series URLs. Content is returned through model output for decodable images and .npy/.csv files.
finding.source: Chat completion content item url field, e.g. image_url.url = file:///path (lmdeploy/serve/processors/multimodal.py:139-164)
finding.sink: ImageMediaIO.load_file open(file_path,'rb') at lmdeploy/vl/media/image.py:31-33; TimeSeriesMediaIO.load_file np.load / np.genfromtxt at lmdeploy/vl/media/time_series.py:31-38

trace.note: image_url string passed to load_from_url with no scheme or path restriction
file scheme or os.path.exists(url) routes to file branch
_load_file_url builds Path from netloc + path with no base-dir check

finding.guards_checked: HTTP-only checks (scheme, private IP, domain allowlist) apply only to the http branch (connection.py:59-93). allowed_media_domains defaults to None (multimodal.py:41). No base-directory restriction or file-scheme block. Auth is off by default. Not verified: whether error messages leak file existence.

finding.claim: DNS-rebinding TOCTOU in HTTP media fetch: _is_safe_url resolves and checks the hostname, then requests.get resolves it again, so a hostname can pass the check with a public IP and fetch from a private IP. Redirects are revalidated per hop.
finding.source: Attacker-supplied http(s) media URL in multimodal content (multimodal.py:162)
finding.sink: requests.get(parsed.url) at lmdeploy/vl/media/connection.py:83 after validation at connection.py:79-81

trace.note: requests.get re-resolves the hostname at fetch time

finding.guards_checked: Scheme check, hostname check, is_global check on all resolved IPs (connection.py:39-50), per-hop revalidation and allow_redirects=False (connection.py:69-90). Not resolved: IPv4-mapped IPv6 handling in is_global. Requires attacker-controlled DNS with short TTL. Confidence PLAUSIBLE.
